thread:
Aisha Patel: FYI — we need to send status + credit offer to accounts impacted by yesterday's inference latency spike. Focus: Dedicated & Private customers with SLOs. Draft, numbers, and technical mitigation by EOD? :eyes:

Luca Moretti: On it. I'll pull the impact list (accounts + committed capacity) and calc potential credits. ETA 2h.

Priya Sharma: I can draft the customer message. Tone idea: transparent, short timeline, steps, and an optional 10% service credit for affected windows. Thoughts?

Marcus Chen: Root cause looks like a KV cache invalidation bug causing hot-path reads to fall back to CPU for some Dedicated pools. Fix is a rollout to runtime v2.3.1 + a small migration that warms caches. Will need a canary and 1-hour rollback window.

incident-bot: Incident RED-2026-03-19: High inference latency affecting Dedicated pools in us-west-2. Details: https://incidents.redwood.ai/RED-2026-03-19

Aisha Patel: Thanks Marcus. Can you provide the exact rollback trigger conditions (metrics) so CS can mention mitigation plan?

Marcus Chen: Rollback triggers:
- p95 latency > 2x baseline for 30m
- error rate increase > 0.5% absolute

I'll paste the rollout commands in a sec.

Marcus Chen:
```
# canary rollout
redwoodctl deploy runtime --version v2.3.1 --subset canary --region us-west-2
# monitor for 30m
```

Luca Moretti: Credit calc idea: For impacted committed accounts, prorate monthly reserved fee by downtime minutes * (SLA penalty %). Quick formula:
```
credit = reserved_monthly_fee * min(1, downtime_minutes / (30*24*60)) * sla_penalty
```
I'll run numbers and attach spreadsheet.

Priya Sharma: Draft headline for customers:

"Status update: temporary latency degradation on Dedicated pools — remediation in progress"
Body bullet points: what happened, who was affected, immediate mitigation, expected timeline, credit offer, contact + next steps.

Aisha Patel: Please share the full draft + list of priority accounts (top 10 ARR) for personalized outreach. Also ops needs to confirm whether any on-prem/private customers were affected.

Denise Park (Legal): Quick note — approved credit wording as "prorated service credit per your Dedicated agreement". No legal changes needed for template.

Luca Moretti: Spreadsheet link: https://redwood.sheets/impacted-credits (private)
Priority accounts flagged; 4 enterprise customers show sustained p95 > target for 45-80m.

Priya Sharma: Posting draft below for quick review:

"Hi <Customer>,
We wanted to let you know about an incident on Mar 19 that caused elevated inference latency for some Dedicated capacity customers. Our engineers identified a cache invalidation issue and are rolling a fix. You may see transient higher latencies over the next hour as the rollout completes. We will credit affected periods per your Dedicated agreement. Next steps: timeline, contact, link to RCA when ready.

If you prefer a sync call, reply and we'll schedule.
"

Marcus Chen: small note: for Private (on-prem) customers, the issue only affects those who pulled the autoscaler image in the last week; most on-prem unaffected but we should coordinate with their infra teams.

Aisha Patel: Good. Can CSOps prepare outbound template + list by noon PST? I'll call for legal approval for credit wording.

Priya Sharma: I can have a polished template in 90m. @Luca please confirm credit numbers.

Luca Moretti: Confirmed. Sending preliminary credit amounts to Aisha and Priya now.

Aisha Patel: Great. One more ask — please capture customer feedback from replies in a shared doc, tag escalations, and loop in AMs for high-touch accounts.

Priya Sharma: Yep, will capture. Adding a short survey link in the outbound: 3 Qs: severity, impact to workflows, follow-up desired.

incident-bot: Update: fix rolled to canary at 12:18 UTC. Monitoring.

Marcus Chen: Canary looks good so far. If metrics hold for 30m we'll begin gradual rollout.

Aisha Patel: Thanks team — we'll proceed with customer outreach once Luca and legal confirm credit phrasing. I'll post final outbound in this thread before sending.

Priya Sharma: lgtm :thumbsup:

Luca Moretti: done — numbers sent.

Aisha Patel: Closing loop: legal approved wording; PR outbound posted below. Proceeding with sends to priority accounts, and larger batch tomorrow.

Priya Sharma: outbound posted — assigning AMs to 4 flagged enterprise accounts. I'll coordinate calls.

Marcus Chen: Rolling to prod now.

incident-bot: Incident RED-2026-03-19: Mitigation complete; status set to MONITORING. RCA draft in progress: https://incidents.redwood.ai/RED-2026-03-19/rca
